intro.text: A highly skilled apothecary from Hrovell, whom the gyorn Hrathen contacts by seon whenever he needs a potion made.

items.text: Years earlier, Forton had cured Hrathen of a poison that nobody else could counter. Since then Hrathen had ordered potions and antidotes from him by seon, valuing him too much to mind that he was a heathen.
Reaching Forton through his seon, Hrathen asked him to brew a special elixir and send it to Arelon as fast as possible.
When Forton's package of vials arrived in Kae, Hrathen, who had meant them for Dilaf, swallowed them himself instead.

Forton's potion made whoever took it look as if the Shaod had taken them. Hrathen used it on himself and on Sarene to stage miraculous healings and gain a hold over King Eventeo. It did exactly what he had asked for, though its effects lasted a little longer than Hrathen expected.

appearance.text: A mouse-faced man with big ears and a persistent cough, who likes to smoke. He speaks the thick, harsh Fjordell dialect of Hrovell.

personality.text: Thoroughly content with life, thanks partly to what he smokes. A follower of the Jeskeri Mysteries and something of a mystic at home, he still claims to be firmly Derethi; his grasp of doctrine is good but patchy, and Hrathen sees the piety as a show.
